scenes.text: The first robot car to drive on another world rolled across the Moon, and it wasn't American.
It was the Soviet rover called Lunokhod one.
It landed on November seventeenth, nineteen seventy.
It touched down on a dark plain called the Sea of Rains.
The rover rolled on eight wheels, and each wheel had its own electric motor.
In daylight, its lid opened to show solar cells that charged its batteries.
During the freezing lunar night, the lid closed and a small radioactive heater kept it warm.
Engineers on Earth steered it with a few simple commands, like forward, turn and stop.
It was only meant to last about three months.
Instead, it kept going for eleven lunar days, roughly ten and a half months.
It drove about ten and a half kilometers and sent back more than twenty thousand TV images.
It carried a French laser reflector, but for decades nobody could hit it with a laser.
Then in twenty ten, NASA orbiter photos showed exactly where it was parked.
Scientists fired a laser at it and got about two thousand photons back on their very first try.
Would you rather drive a rover on the Moon or on Mars?

title: The first rover on another world wasn't American 🚙
caption: Lunokhod 1 landed on the Moon on Nov 17, 1970. Built to last 3 months, it drove about 10.5 km over nearly 11 months.
